name: OAP checks call records within two business days (r. 25(4)(b))

attrs.quote: examine communication detail records, within two business days from the date of receipt of complaint by OAP
attrs.scope: Originating Access Providers, for complaints against registered Senders or RTMs
attrs.note: Regulation 25(5)(b) sets the same two business days for complaints against unregistered telemarketers.
